description: Semver build metadata in npm versions, read from yarn.lock (yarn berry). The root (1.0.0+root) and two workspace members (3.0.0+ws, @acme/tools 0.9.0+exp.sha.5114f85) must keep their recorded version, escape '+' as %2B in the purl exactly once, keep the decoded form in bom-ref and dependency refs, and carry cdx:npm:cleanedVersion with the version npm publish would record. The file: tarball is recorded as 2.0.0+local and is treated the same way. left-pad@1.3.0 is the control that carries no cleaned version.
